# Spell Check Skill

Check for spelling errors in markdown files at the top level of the repository.

## Purpose

This skill helps identify spelling errors in the main markdown documentation files to ensure content quality and professionalism.

## Scope

This skill applies to:
- All `.md` files in the root directory of the repository
- Examples: `about.md`, `history.md`, `index.md`, `events.md`, etc.

## How to Use

### Configure Spelling Dictionary

A `.cspell.json` configuration file has been created in the root directory with:
- Project-specific place names (Caledonian, Glasgow, Uddingston, Anniesland, etc.)
- Philatelic terminology (FRPSL, Bourse, etc.)
- Common member names that appear in meeting records
- Exclude patterns for URLs

## Common Spelling Issues to Watch For

- Proper nouns: Caledonian, Glasgow, Uddingston
- Philatelic terms: postage, cancellation, perforation
- Scottish names and places
- Historical terms and abbreviations
